name: Hako no Naka no Neko
source:
Waldo is a young viscount. One day on a hunt he meets a cat ear girl. He lives double life now - one between butlers and maids and the other one with the girl in the forest.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
沃尔多是一位年轻的子爵。有一天，他在一次狩猎中遇到了一位猫耳女孩。他现在过着双重生活——一种是管家和女仆，另一种是和森林里的女孩在一起。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
